description: Korean sole proprietor: bookkeeping vs estimated (추계) income tax filing. Decides simple-ledger vs double-entry duty (prior-year revenue 300M/150M/75M by industry group, 소득세법 시행령 제208조), simple vs standard expense ratio eligibility (60M/36M/24M; personal services 36M, 제143조), standard-ratio income capped at simple-ratio income × 3.4 (2.8 for simple-ledger filers, through tax year 2027), no-bookkeeping penalty = calculated tax × business income share × 20% (제81조의5; exempt for new businesses and prior revenue under 48M), and the bookkeeping tax credit 20% capped at 1M for simple-ledger filers using double entry (제56조의2). Uses basic rates with personal deductions only. Estimate only; no filing.

group.description: a = agriculture/wholesale-retail/real estate sales, b = manufacturing/food & lodging/construction/IT/finance, c = rental/professional services/education/health/arts/personal services, personal = VAT-exempt personal services (freelancers)

majorExpense.description: Documented purchases, rent and payroll (for the standard ratio)

otherIncome.description: Other comprehensive income amount (e.g. wage income amount)

simpleRate.description: Simple expense ratio % for the industry code

simpleRateOver.description: Simple expense ratio % for revenue above 40M (자가율); default = simpleRate

standardRate.description: Standard expense ratio % for the industry code
